thesis: 企業の実体が改善しているのに、保有者の縮小など観測可能な売り手フローと相対株価低迷が重なる局面では、単純な低PERよりも再評価余地のある候補を見つけられる可能性がある。
economic_mechanism: Fundamental improvement and valuation compression can coexist when ownership-driven supply is temporarily stronger than changes in operating reality. The hypothesis requires observed seller-flow evidence and does not infer forced liquidation without direct evidence.

required_features: latest annual and interim revenue / operating income / net income trajectory
company TSR and comparison-index TSR from the same disclosure record
large-shareholding changes with filer, date, prior ratio and current ratio
earnings revisions, dividend revisions and other material corporate events

falsifiers: Latest revenue, operating income, net income or operating cash flow turns negative year-on-year without a separately documented temporary cause.
Valuation ceases to satisfy the pre-registered weak-case margin thresholds at the information cutoff.
Observed relative underperformance is accompanied by a negative earnings revision or other fundamental event sufficient to explain the repricing.
The claimed seller-flow mechanism cannot be tied to dated large-shareholding or equivalent supply evidence.
Thresholds or required features are changed after inspecting the candidate outcome without a new hypothesis version.
